channel.title: Daily Recap — 🏰 Disney News
channel.description: What happened in 🏰 Disney News, recapped daily from subscribed feeds.

item.title: Disney World is removing the MagicBand+ character statues — the writing on the wall for MagicBands
item.description:
Walt Disney World has started removing the Fab 50 character statues, one of the marquee interactive features of MagicBand+. The statues were designed to react when guests wearing a MagicBand+ waved at them, and their removal is the latest sign that Disney is quietly stepping back from the wearable.

The move fits a pattern: MagicBands were once positioned as the centerpiece of the parks' tech ecosystem, but their role has steadily shrunk as phones have taken over ticketing, payments, and Lightning Lane access. Removing the statues doesn't kill MagicBand+ outright, but it strips away one of the few things that made the bands feel special rather than redundant.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney World Removing MagicBand+ Character Statues

item.title: Extended Evening Hours moves away from Magic Kingdom this winter — and back to Animal Kingdom
item.description:
Walt Disney World continues to shuffle the schedule for Extended Evening Hours, the perk for deluxe-resort guests, moving it away from Magic Kingdom in Winter 2027. The latest twist is that the event is unexpectedly returning to Animal Kingdom in February.

The rotation matters because the perk's value varies a lot by park: at Animal Kingdom, the limited ride lineup and early-evening animal behavior make the extra hours a different proposition than a Magic Kingdom evening. Guests planning winter trips around the perk should check the schedule carefully, since the park hosting it is no longer the predictable Magic Kingdom slot it used to be.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Extended Evening Hours Perk Moves from Magic Kingdom in Winter 2027

item.title: When will Spaceship Earth close for its first major update in nearly 20 years?
item.description:
Earlier this fall, Walt Disney World announced that Spaceship Earth at EPCOT is getting its first major update in nearly 20 years — a lengthy refurbishment that will close the park's icon for months. Fans are now wondering when the closure will actually begin, with speculation pointing to sometime in 2027 or beyond.

The timing matters for trip planning: Spaceship Earth is both EPCOT's visual centerpiece and a beloved slow dark ride, and a multi-month closure removes one of the park's signature experiences. Based on past refurbishments, the downtime is expected to stretch for months rather than weeks, so visitors with 2027 trips should watch for an official closure date before locking in plans.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: When Will Spaceship Earth Close for Reimagining?

item.title: The biggest Black Friday Week deals for Disney fans in 2026
item.description:
Black Friday Week is underway, and the roundup of the best deals for Disney fans covers toys, travel gadgets, books, LEGOs, home goods, electronics, and Christmas decor — plus the gear that makes a Walt Disney World or Disneyland trip smoother. It's a practical guide for gift shopping and for stocking up on vacation essentials before the holiday rush.

The deals are expected to get even better as the week progresses, so the advice is to check back rather than buy everything on day one. For Disney-loving kids and for adults planning a 2027 trip, the highlights are the travel and park-gear picks, where the discounts tend to be deepest.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Biggest 2026 Black Friday Week Deals for Disney Fans!

item.title: New book paints a harsh portrait of Bob Iger's Disney succession war
item.description:
A new unauthorized book, The House of Mouse: Bob Iger and The War of Succession at Disney, offers what the New York Times calls a "rigorous reassessment" of the former CEO — and the early preview is not flattering to Iger. The book digs into the battle between Iger and his successor Bob Chapek, the messy handover, and Iger's eventual return to run the company.

For Disney watchers, it's the first full unauthorized account of one of the most turbulent chapters in the company's modern history. The preview suggests Iger comes off badly, which cuts against the polished narrative of his celebrated tenure. Expect the book to fuel plenty of debate among fans and industry watchers about who was really responsible for Disney's recent struggles.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Bob Iger Looks Bad in Disney ‘War of Succession’ Book

item.title: Avengers: Doomsday takes over Disney parks dining — and a Doctor Doom popcorn bucket
item.description:
Disney is going all-in on Avengers: Doomsday, its biggest movie event since 2019's Endgame, with a global food rollout across its parks. The foodie guide covers themed dishes and drinks at Disneyland Resort, Hong Kong Disneyland, Tokyo Disney Resort, Disneyland Paris, and even Disney Cruise Line, with culinary teams serving up offerings "fit for heroes and villains alike."

The standout collectible is a Doctor Doom throne popcorn bucket, the kind of limited souvenir that reliably draws long lines at the parks. The film arrives December 18, 2026, and Disney is clearly treating it as a franchise-reviving tentpole after a mixed run for the Marvel Cinematic Universe since Endgame. The parks tie-in is a big part of the bet.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Foodie Guide to Avengers: Doomsday
  • Disney Tourist Blog: New Doctor Doom Throne Popcorn Bucket Highlights Food Coming to Disney Parks for Avengers Doomsday

item.title: Disney brings its new film 'Hexed' from the premiere to the parks
item.description:
Disney is carrying the magic of its new film Hexed from the purple carpet premiere straight into the parks. Guests at Disneyland Resort in California and Walt Disney World Resort in Florida can experience a taste of the film's world for themselves, with themed offerings bringing the movie's spellbinding setting to life in person.

It's the familiar Disney playbook — premiere buzz feeding park experiences and vice versa — but the speed of the rollout shows how closely the studio and parks divisions now coordinate around a new release. For fans who can't wait to step into the film's world, the parks are the next best thing to the screen.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: From the Purple Carpet Premiere to Disney Parks: Inside the Spellbinding World of Disney’s ‘Hexed’

item.title: Disney at the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
item.description:
Disney will have a prominent presence at the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade in 2026, with a balloon and float lineup that builds on a 90-year history between the company and the parade. For many families, the parade is as much a holiday tradition as the meal itself — the balloons, floats, and musical performances on TV mark the start of the heart of the holiday season.

The centennial edition is a milestone for the parade, and Disney's deep involvement reflects how intertwined the two institutions have become. It's one of those annual moments where Disney's cultural footprint is on full display, beamed into living rooms across the country.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney at the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade in 2026: Balloon & Float Lineup Builds 90-Year History

item.title: Black Friday week brings Disney deals — including 10% back on gift cards
item.description:
Black Friday Week is underway, and Disney fans have plenty to sort through: deals on toys, LEGOs, electronics, Christmas decor, travel gadgets, and more, plus vacation-focused savings for Walt Disney World and Disneyland trips. A new offer gives 10% back on Disney gift cards, joining the usual gift card deals at Sam's Club, Target, and Best Buy that typically anchor the season.

The gift card angle is the one worth watching for park-goers, since discounted Disney gift cards effectively cut the price of tickets, hotels, and food. With even better doorbusters expected over the long weekend, the advice is to grab the gift card deals now and keep an eye out for deeper cuts as Black Friday itself approaches.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Biggest 2026 Black Friday Week Deals for Disney Fans!
  • Disney Tourist Blog: Black Friday Deal: Get 10% Back on Disney Gift Cards

item.title: Animal Kingdom tests a nighttime safari: Kilimanjaro Safaris: Twilight Tales
item.description:
Walt Disney World is testing a new nighttime version of its signature Animal Kingdom attraction: Kilimanjaro Safaris: Twilight Tales. The announcement came one day after the park extended its hours across the board for late 2026 and early 2027, suggesting the evening safari is part of a broader push to make Animal Kingdom a genuine after-dark destination.

Details on what the Twilight Tales overlay changes — narration, lighting, animal behavior after dark — are still emerging as testing proceeds. But a nighttime safari has long been on fans' wish lists, and if the test goes well it could become a permanent reason to stay at Animal Kingdom past sunset.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney World Testing New ‘Twilight Tales’ Night Safari at Animal Kingdom!

item.title: Universal's Horror Make-Up Show returns with Blumhouse; Epic Universe ride closes for refurb
item.description:
Universal Orlando has announced a reimagined version of its beloved Horror Make-Up Show, this time featuring Blumhouse, debuting in December. The long-running stage show — a fan favorite for its mix of practical-effects demos and comedy — gets a new horror-studio partner for its next act.

Alongside the debut, Universal flagged several upcoming and ongoing ride refurbishments and closures across Epic Universe, Islands of Adventure, and Universal Studios Florida, including an Epic Universe ride closing for refurbishment in December. Guests planning holiday trips should check closure schedules before locking in park days.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Universal Horror Make-Up Show with Blumhouse Debuts & Epic Universe Ride Closes for Refurb in December

item.title: Disney+ Black Friday sale: bundle from $4.99 a month, 61% off
item.description:
Disney has brought back its best streaming sale of the year, with deals on two tiers of the Disney+ and Hulu bundle starting at $4.99 per month — 61% off, or roughly $100 saved over the course of a year.

For Disney World planners, the sale matters beyond streaming: the Disney+ subscription is also the gateway to some of the best 2027 vacation package deals, so the Black Friday pricing doubles as a way into discounted trips. The offer is the year's lowest entry point for the bundle, and the savings angle is aimed squarely at households weighing whether to subscribe or renew.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Unlock Disney World’s Best 2027 Deals with Disney+ Black Friday Streaming Sale

item.title: Magic Kingdom's best counter-service spot gets even better
item.description:
Magic Kingdom is Walt Disney World's worst food park by most accounts — its counter-service spots are mostly crowded, chaotic cafeterias with limited menus. The one big exception is Columbia Harbour House, and a new review says the park's top quick-service restaurant is even better than ever.

For anyone planning a Magic Kingdom day, the takeaway is simple: skip the generic cafeteria lines and head to Columbia Harbour House, still the rare counter-service meal in the park that feels like a genuine highlight rather than a refueling stop.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Magic Kingdom’s #1 Restaurant Is Even Better Than Ever

item.title: Disney Cruise Line swaps gingerbread houses for towers fleet-wide
item.description:
Disney Cruise Line has replaced its traditional gingerbread houses with gingerbread towers across the fleet for the Very Merrytime holiday sailings — the latest front in what fans are calling Disney's war on the classic gingerbread house. The towers are no small undertaking: each display uses more than 700 pounds of powdered sugar and fondant, 1,300 pounds of gingerbread mix, and the work of 80 crew members.

The change has split fans, with some mourning the cozy houses and others embracing the taller, more dramatic displays. Love them or not, the towers are now the fleet-wide holiday centerpiece, and they're hard to miss in the atriums. If you're sailing over the holidays, expect the towers — and the debate — to be part of the experience.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Behind the Scenes: New Gingerbread Towers Bring Sweet Holiday Magic to Disney Cruise Line
  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney Cruise Line Debuts Controversial Gingerbread Towers Across Fleet, Replacing Houses

item.title: Disney World extends park hours, with a surprise boost at Animal Kingdom
item.description:
Walt Disney World has extended park hours for its busiest week of the year at Magic Kingdom and Hollywood Studios, and — more unexpectedly — at Animal Kingdom for Christmas 2026 and into early 2027. The Animal Kingdom extensions are the real surprise, since the park has historically closed earlier than its siblings.

The likely read is that Disney expects strong holiday crowds and wants to spread them across more hours, with Animal Kingdom's newer evening offerings giving guests a reason to stay after dark. For trip planners, the longer hours mean more flexibility over the holidays, but also a signal: book dining and Lightning Lanes early, because the parks are bracing for a packed Christmas season.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Why Did Disney World Just Make Surprise Park Hours Extensions at Animal Kingdom for Late 2026 & 2027?

item.title: Avengers: Doomsday takes over the parks, with new heroes to meet
item.description:
With Avengers: Doomsday hitting theaters December 18, Disney is rolling out film tie-ins across both U.S. resorts. At Disneyland, Avengers Campus gets heroic encounters with Bucky Barnes and Yelena Belova, plus themed food and merchandise celebrating the new film. And at both Walt Disney World and Disneyland, new meet-and-greets are arriving featuring characters from the holiday season's big releases — Doomsday and the animated tentpole Hexed.

The Florida additions are the pleasant surprise here, since character debuts tied to new films more often land first in California. If you're visiting over the holidays, expect Doomsday to be hard to miss — and expect the new character lines to be popular, so plan them early in the day.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Bucky Barnes and Yelena Belova Debut in Avengers Campus
  • Disney Tourist Blog: Meet & Greet Characters Coming to Disney World & Disneyland from New Holiday 2026 Tentpoles

item.title: The Muppets are having a moment this Christmas at Disney World
item.description:
The Muppets are having a moment right now at Walt Disney World. The reimagined Rock 'n' Roller Coaster — now Muppet-themed — is one of the hottest rides at the resort, and just got more popular with its not-so-obligatory holiday overlay. Meanwhile, The Muppet Christmas Carol has graduated from cult classic to seasonal staple.

It's a well-timed surge: the Muppets are a natural fit for Christmas, and Disney seems to be leaning into the nostalgia just as the holiday crowds arrive. If you're heading to Hollywood Studios this season, expect the Muppets to be everywhere.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: The Muppets Are Having a Moment This Christmas

item.title: Lightning Lane Premier Pass is selling out at record-high prices — but is it worth it?
item.description:
Walt Disney World's top-tier Lightning Lane Premier Pass has sold out at all four parks for a nearly week-long stretch ahead of Thanksgiving — even though prices have hit new record highs. Single Pass is also unavailable across the same stretch.

The sellouts are the latest evidence that Disney's most expensive skip-the-line product has demand to spare, at least during peak holiday weeks. Whether it's worth it depends on how you value your time: the pass lets you ride nearly everything once without booking windows, but at these prices it's a serious add-on to an already expensive trip. For Thanksgiving week, at least, the market has spoken.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Lightning Lane Premier Pass Is Selling Out at New Record High Prices, But Is It Worth It?

item.title: Hong Kong Disneyland's Black Friday deal: 40% off hotels and 3-day tickets for the price of 2
item.description:
It's rare for Disney to run Black Friday sales for its parks and resorts at all, let alone offer deep discounts — which makes Hong Kong Disneyland's annual sale on 2027 stays the standout Disney deal of the season: 40% off hotels and 3-day park tickets for the price of two.

The sale applies to just two hotels, so the inventory is limited, but for anyone planning a Hong Kong trip in 2027, it's a genuine bargain by Disney standards. US parks aren't offering anything comparable this year.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney's Best Black Friday Deal: 40% Off Hotels & 3-Day Tickets for Price of 2 at Hong Kong Disneyland

item.title: EPCOT's beloved Christmas greenhouse overlay extended into 2027
item.description:
Walt Disney World has extended its best Christmas ride overlay into 2027. Living with the Land: Glimmering Greenhouses, the holiday transformation of the EPCOT boat ride, will keep running beyond this season, even after the resort added a trio of ride overlays for Christmas 2026.

The overlay has become the standout seasonal offering at the park, growing bigger and better each year as part of the EPCOT Festival of the Holidays. For guests planning a holiday trip, it's good news: the most popular Christmas ride experience at Walt Disney World isn't going anywhere next year.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney World Extends Best Christmas Ride Overlay Into 2027

item.title: Disney World stays quiet on gingerbread displays as the Grand Floridian house retires
item.description:
The holiday season is underway at Walt Disney World, and gingerbread houses and other Christmas culinary creations are up around the resort hotels. But the resort is taking a noticeably different approach this year: it's been quiet about the displays, the flagship gingerbread house at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort has been retired, and other displays have shrunk in size.

The changes follow new resort restrictions, and they mark a real shift for a tradition many guests plan trips around. The displays are still there to enjoy, but fans expecting the usual fanfare and the grand centerpiece at the Grand Floridian will find a more subdued holiday scene this year.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney World Quiet on Gingerbread Displays After Resort Restrictions & Retiring Grand Floridian House

item.title: The least-bad weeks to visit Disney World in 2027
item.description:
Not everyone can visit Walt Disney World during its best weeks, so Disney Tourist Blog has ranked the least-bad options for 2027. The park's core audience of families with young children is largely limited to school breaks, long weekends, and peak holiday weeks, which is exactly when crowds surge.

The guide walks through the weeks when school is out but crowds stay comparatively manageable, helping planners pick dates that balance a workable schedule with a less punishing park experience. For anyone locked into a school-break window next year, it's a practical starting point for choosing dates before booking.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Least-Bad Worst Weeks to Visit Disney World in 2027

item.title: Black Friday Week brings the biggest Disney deals of 2026
item.description:
Black Friday Week is underway, and Disney Tourist Blog has rounded up the best deals for Disney fans. The sale covers toys, travel gadgets, books, LEGOs, home goods, electronics, and Christmas decor, with picks aimed at both Walt Disney World and Disneyland vacations and gifts for Disney-loving kids.

The roundup was updated on November 21 and runs through the week before Thanksgiving, so the best prices are live now. For anyone planning a park trip or shopping for a Disney fan, it's worth scanning the list before the week ends.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Biggest 2026 Black Friday Week Deals for Disney Fans!

item.title: Review: the new Mary Blair rooms at Bay Lake Tower, Disney World's closest resort to Magic Kingdom
item.description:
Disney Tourist Blog has reviewed the new Mary Blair-themed rooms at Bay Lake Tower, Walt Disney World's closest resort to Magic Kingdom. The tower sits even closer than the main A-frame of Disney's Contemporary Resort, with a total walk of under 10 minutes from hotel door to the park's main entrance.

The review praises the refreshed rooms, which celebrate the legendary Disney artist's style, and finds a new appreciation for the resort's unbeatable location. For guests weighing a Magic Kingdom stay, the combination of fresh rooms and a walk shorter than most resort bus rides makes Bay Lake Tower a strong contender.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Review: Marvelous New Rooms at Disney World’s Closest Resort to Magic Kingdom!

item.title: Disney World raises Christmas ticket prices and offers a 3-park deal that skips Magic Kingdom
item.description:
Walt Disney World has raised single-day ticket prices for late December, hitting new peak-season highs for the most expensive dates of 2026. Christmas week was already the priciest time to visit; now the ceiling is higher still.

Alongside the increase, Disney released a new "special offer" on admission for guests willing to skip Magic Kingdom at Christmas — a 3-park ticket covering the other parks. It's a telling trade: Magic Kingdom on Christmas Day is the park's most crowded experience, so Disney is effectively discounting the trip for anyone willing to avoid the crush. If you're planning a holiday visit, the math is worth doing before you buy.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney World Raises Christmas 2026 Ticket Prices & Debuts New 3-Park “Deal”

item.title: Victoria & Albert's ranks among America's top 10 restaurants as Jiko regains its Four Diamond status
item.description:
A month after a trio of Walt Disney World restaurants earned Michelin recognition, more accolades have arrived. Victoria & Albert's at the Grand Floridian has ranked among the top 10 restaurants in the United States, and Jiko — The Cooking Place at Animal Kingdom Lodge has regained its AAA Four Diamond designation.

The honors underline something regular Disney visitors already know: the resort's fine dining can stand with the best in the country, not just the best in a theme park. For anyone planning a special-occasion meal on a Disney trip, these two are the ones to book early — Victoria & Albert's in particular is notoriously hard to get into.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Flagship Disney World Restaurant Ranks Top 10 in US & Jiko Regains AAA Four Diamond Designation

item.title: ShopRite offers $20 back on a $100 Disney gift card
item.description:
Black Friday gift card deals keep coming, and this one is from an unexpected source: ShopRite is offering $20 back when you buy a $100 Disney gift card. The big players — Sam's Club, Target, and Best Buy — have already run their usual Disney gift card discounts, but a 20% return from a regional grocer is one of the better rates of the season.

Disney gift cards are effectively cash at the parks, resorts, and Disney Store, so a 20% discount is a straight saving on a trip you're already planning. The catch, as always with regional deals, is availability: not everyone has a ShopRite nearby, and quantities may be limited.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Buy $100 Disney Gift Card & Get $20 Back at ShopRite

item.title: Disney's 'Hexed' arrives in theaters November 26 with a full wave of merch
item.description:
Disney's new animated adventure Hexed hits theaters Thursday, November 26, and the parks are ready with spell-themed merchandise, books, collectibles, and beauty finds tied to the world of Hexe. The film is positioned as Disney's big holiday-season animated release, landing right in the Thanksgiving weekend window.

For families heading to the parks over the holidays, expect Hexed to be everywhere — and if the movie connects the way Disney hopes, its characters will likely start showing up in the parks themselves before long. The merch push ahead of opening day is the usual signal that Disney has high hopes for this one.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Get Ready for Disney’s ‘Hexed’ with Magical Merch, Books, and More

item.title: Hallmark's first Disney World movie, 'Holiday Ever After,' premieres this season
item.description:
Hallmark is rolling out its first-ever movie set at Walt Disney World Resort: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True. The film puts the resort itself front and center — the tree, the lights, the whole Christmas-at-Disney spectacle — as the backdrop for a holiday romance.

It's a natural crossover for two brands built on cozy seasonal sentiment, and Disney is leaning into it with celebrations at the resort tied to the film. If you've ever wanted to see the parks play themselves in a Christmas movie, this is the one.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Cinematic Celebrations for ‘Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True’

item.title: Saratoga Springs adds another refurbishment, with more work likely in 2027 and 2028
item.description:
Walt Disney World has added another refurbishment to the closure calendar at Saratoga Springs Resort & Spa, this time a pool project for 2027. It's a relatively minor closure that shouldn't ruin anyone's vacation, but it continues construction that's been ongoing at the resort this year — and work is expected to continue beyond what's been announced, likely into 2027 and 2028.

If you're booking Saratoga Springs for next year, it's worth checking which pools and amenities will be affected during your dates. The resort remains a popular DVC stay, and Disney has a habit of rolling refurbishments, so one project's end may just be another's beginning.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: New Refurbishments at Disney’s Saratoga Springs Resort, with More Likely to Come in 2027 or 2028
